meta.name: ultragoal
meta.description: Autonomous multi-story objective-pursuit executor — restructures goal into a per-story sequential loop. Auto-generates and bulk-approves a Story set, dispatches each confirmed story to sisyphus one at a time gated by a per-story APPROVE verdict, then runs one independent code-review over the accumulated diff at the final story.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将大目标拆解为小故事并逐个执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化管理多个开发故事并进行代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically break down large goals into stories and execute them sequentially
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate managing multiple development stories with code review

howto.what: Ultragoal 会把你提出的目标自动拆分成多个小步骤，让你一次确认所有步骤。然后按顺序逐个执行，每步完成后需要你批准才能进入下一步，全部完成后自动进行代码审查。
howto.when: 当你提出一个具体可验证的目标（如通过测试、完成功能），或者明确表示要延续之前的目标时触发。

say.text: 把我的目标分解成步骤并执行，让所有测试通过。
say.note: Ultragoal 会自动拆分并逐个执行，每步需你批准。
它会恢复上次未完成的任务。

say.text: 帮我实现一个用户注册功能。
say.note: 它会把该功能分解成步骤执行。

howto.what_en: Ultragoal automatically breaks your objective into multiple small steps (stories) for you to review and approve in bulk. It then executes them one by one, requiring your approval after each step, and finally runs an independent code review on the accumulated changes.
howto.when_en: When you propose a concrete, verifiable objective (e.g., passing tests, completing a feature), or when you explicitly ask to continue a previous objective.

say_en.text: Break my objective into steps and execute them, all tests must pass.
say_en.note: Ultragoal will split and execute step by step, each step needs your approval.
It will resume the unfinished task.
It will decompose that feature into steps and execute.
